subject: Physics
prompt: Which of the following is the dimensional formula of acceleration?
explanation_steps: Acceleration is change in velocity over time, velocity is LT^{-1}, so acceleration is LT^{-2}.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which fundamental unit is the same in both SI and British system of units?
explanation_steps: Time unit second is the same in both systems.

subject: Physics
prompt: The sides of a rectangle are 5.07 m and 15 m. Taking the significant figures into account the area of the rectangle is
explanation_steps: 15 m has 2 significant figures, so area is 76 m².
